verdicts.reason: A keeps the original's logo, headline-plus-subline block and CTA together and aligned on a common middle axis, but it is basically the 728x90 layout dropped into the taller canvas: thick empty bands sit above and below, and the type is undersized for a 192px-tall banner. B breaks the headline group: 'Chase the light' sits near the top while the subline drops about 70px below it, so the two no longer read as one unit. B's subline has also shrunk to barely legible fine print, the CTA has shrunk, and the CTA's vertical position doesn't line up with the headline, the subline or the logo.
